Title: Festive Umbraco
Description: Festive Umbraco temporarily transforms the Umbraco backoffice into a festive experience during date ranges you choose. It includes eight seasonal themes — Christmas, Halloween, New Year, Diwali, Valentine's Day, Easter, St Patrick's Day, and Thanksgiving — each with its own subtle background effect, occasional themed cameo, and celebratory toast when content is published. Run a single theme for one occasion or plan the whole year ahead with a schedule that switches automatically. The package is backoffice-only, off by default, and never affects your content or front end.
